verdict.rationale: Featurebase's core offering is a centralized feedback portal with public roadmap and voting, described as easy to set up without engineering (no-code integrations, custom domain branding), which supports self-serve PM setup. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit onboarding walkthroughs, setup-time claims, or independent hands-on confirmation that a non-technical PM can launch it unaided. missing for 10: step-by-step no-code setup documentation, independent user testimonials/reviews confirming no-engineering-needed setup, explicit time-to-launch claims.
